clauses.text: Individual annual in-network deductible: $500.00. Apply to covered allowance before copay and coinsurance unless the benefit explicitly waives it.
Individual annual in-network OOP maximum: $1500.00. Cap covered deductible, copay and coinsurance together. Exclusions and permitted balance bills do not count. Network pools are separate.
Covered participating-provider charges above the allowed amount must be written off; no balance billing.
Individual annual out-network deductible: $1000.00. Apply to covered allowance before copay and coinsurance unless the benefit explicitly waives it.
Individual annual out-network OOP maximum: $3000.00. Cap covered deductible, copay and coinsurance together. Exclusions and permitted balance bills do not count. Network pools are separate.
Out-of-network charges above the allowed amount may be balance billed under this fictional plan; outside OOP.
Covered in-network ambulatory procedure (29881): deductible then 20% coinsurance; subject to OOP maximum.
In-network elective cosmetic service (15820) is excluded at full billed charge; no deductible or OOP credit.
Out-of-network nonemergency transport (A0428): deductible then 50% member coinsurance; permitted balance billing applies.

One visit/unit per line. Apply deductible, then copay, then member coinsurance on the remaining allowance. Round coinsurance half up to cents. Apply OOP cap in that order. Process by service date, then line ID. Excluded services are member liability at full charge. This is an illustrative individual USD plan only.
